entries.original_title: Daybreak Red from OpenAI now available to eligible customers on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
entries.subtitle: Eligible defenders can use OpenAI's Daybreak Red on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US-East) for authorized vulnerability research and mitigation work.
entries.reject_reason: Daybreak Red's availability in another Bedrock region is not the launch of a new model or major product.

entries.original_title: Web Search now available on Kiro in AWS GovCloud (US)
entries.subtitle: Kiro web search gives agents current internet information with citations, while administrators can disable search and page fetching for their organization.
entries.reject_reason: This extends an existing Kiro web-search feature to GovCloud rather than introducing a new feature.

entries.original_title: microsoft/Mage-VL-Cowork
entries.subtitle: Microsoft's 4B model combines screen-based actions with code for computer tasks, addressing the limits of agents that use only clicks or tools alone.
entries.reject_reason: The raw upload identifies Mage-VL-Cowork as a fine-tune of an existing Mage-VL checkpoint, which the model-release rules exclude.

entries.original_title: Things That Go Beep in the Night: Agentic AI Joins the Search for Extraterrestrial Signals
entries.subtitle: Breakthrough Listen and the SETI Institute use AI agents to control telescope tasks and analyze data, which may speed searches for extraterrestrial signals.
entries.reject_reason: This primarily describes a third-party SETI application of existing NVIDIA technology rather than NVIDIA research or a launch.

entries.original_title: Build Specialized Agents on a Stack You Control with NVIDIA NemoClaw
entries.subtitle: NVIDIA NemoClaw provides a controlled stack with policy enforcement and tools to help developers run autonomous agents more safely on enterprise systems.
entries.reject_reason: The article explains how to build agents with NVIDIA NemoClaw but does not establish a new product launch.

entries.original_title: Cohere Advances C$4 Billion AI Commitment in Canada, Creating 1,500+ Jobs
entries.subtitle: Cohere expects its Canada investments to create more than 1,500 jobs and deliver more than C$4 billion in research and infrastructure investment through 2031.
entries.reject_reason: Cohere's investment and hiring commitments are company news, not a research result or launch.

entries.original_title: Build a Validated Kubernetes Runtime for NVIDIA Dynamo
entries.subtitle: The guide covers the GPU, scheduling, networking, and monitoring setup needed to validate NVIDIA Dynamo deployments on Kubernetes beyond basic deployment.
entries.reject_reason: The article is deployment guidance for existing NVIDIA Dynamo software, not a new result or launch.

entries.original_title: nemotron-halloween
entries.subtitle: A Halloween projection called MonsterHouse listens to visitors and answers as a grumpy pirate, using NVIDIA Nemotron voice tools on one workstation.
entries.reject_reason: This Halloween project demonstrates existing NVIDIA models rather than announcing a new model, product, or research result.

entries.original_title: Q3 Earnings: Andy Jassy on why demand for Amazon’s custom chips keeps growing
entries.subtitle: Amazon's chip business grew triple digit percentages year over year, while Graviton and Trainium revenue commitments each rose more than 20x.
entries.reject_reason: Amazon's earnings commentary reports chip demand and plans but does not launch a product or present research.

entries.original_title: Run AI Models for Edge Application Development with Just a Few Commands
entries.subtitle: Developers can run models for edge agents that monitor vehicles, guide robots, and coordinate factory machines within tight resource limits.
entries.reject_reason: This is guidance on running existing AI models for edge development rather than an announcement.

entries.original_title: Q3 Earnings: Andy Jassy on why AWS growth keeps accelerating
entries.subtitle: AWS grew 39.3% year over year for the sixth straight quarter, while its backlog reached $578 billion amid rising Core and AI demand.
entries.reject_reason: AWS growth and capacity figures are earnings commentary rather than a qualifying launch or research result.

entries.original_title: Amazon Connect Customer now supports versioning and aliasing for flows
entries.subtitle: Flow versions and aliases let teams test updates before release, then redirect connected queues and phone numbers with one change instead of relinking each resource.
entries.reject_reason: Flow versioning and aliasing are general deployment features despite Amazon Connect Customer's AI branding.

entries.original_title: Fair use benefits everyone
entries.subtitle: OpenAI shares court-brief excerpts arguing that fair use supports AI training and innovation, adding creator, academic, accessibility, and legal perspectives to the debate.
entries.reject_reason: OpenAI's discussion of fair-use court briefs is not a research result, product update, or model launch.

entries.original_title: amd/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct_rai_1.9.0_m_1.0.1_npu
entries.subtitle: AMD uploaded several text-generation models tagged for Ryzen AI NPUs to Hugging Face, giving developers more model options.
entries.reject_reason: These are AMD NPU conversions of existing third-party models, not new AMD-named models.

entries.original_title: How to Check and Configure NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage for Your Platform
entries.subtitle: NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage configuration can improve data bandwidth and latency while reducing CPU and memory use across on-premises and cloud platforms.
entries.reject_reason: This is configuration guidance for existing NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage.

entries.original_title: Amazon Connect Customer automatically saves in-progress emails as drafts
entries.subtitle: Amazon Connect Customer saves unfinished emails with recipients and attachments, so agents can resume after interruptions without losing draft progress.
entries.reject_reason: Automatic email drafts in Amazon Connect are not an AI-related update within the stated interests.

entries.original_title: Amazon CloudFront now provides viewer ISP and post-quantum TLS details
entries.subtitle: CloudFront's new headers identify viewers' internet providers and TLS settings, helping teams inspect network performance and measure post-quantum cryptography use.
entries.reject_reason: New CloudFront network and TLS headers are unrelated to the specified AI interests.

entries.original_title: Q3 Earnings: Andy Jassy on faster delivery, lowering cost to serve, groceries, pharmacy, and AI shopping
entries.subtitle: Amazon Stores units grew nearly 15% year over year, and gross sales rose more than $90 billion in the trailing 12 months.
entries.reject_reason: This retail earnings update does not announce an AI research result, product, or model.

entries.original_title: AWS WAF announces automatic SDK integration for Amazon CloudFront distributions
entries.subtitle: AWS WAF can add its JavaScript SDK automatically to CloudFront pages, reducing manual setup and missing client signals for supported managed protections.
entries.reject_reason: Automatic AWS WAF SDK integration is a web-security feature, not an AI update.

entries.original_title: Amazon MSK now supports TLS 1.3 for data in transit
entries.subtitle: Amazon MSK now offers TLS 1.3 policies for provisioned clusters, letting customers strengthen encryption and prepare for post-quantum cryptography.
entries.reject_reason: TLS 1.3 support for Amazon MSK is unrelated to AI research, products, or models.

entries.original_title: Managed Prometheus collectors now support Amazon MSK consumer-group metrics
entries.subtitle: Managed Prometheus collectors now gather Amazon MSK consumer-group metrics, helping teams track Kafka performance and find processing bottlenecks without running collection agents.
entries.reject_reason: MSK consumer-group monitoring metrics do not match the AI interests.

entries.original_title: AWS Glue Data Catalog now supports Apache Iceberg table optimization in the US West (N. California) Region
entries.subtitle: AWS Glue can optimize Apache Iceberg tables in US West (N. California), compacting files and removing unused data to improve queries and control storage costs.
entries.reject_reason: This is regional availability for an existing data-catalog feature, not an AI launch.

entries.original_title: Amazon RDS for Oracle no longer requires automatic minor version upgrades for JVM, Spatial, Locator, and OLAP options
entries.subtitle: RDS for Oracle users can disable automatic minor upgrades for JVM, Spatial, Locator, and OLAP options, but should still apply security updates regularly.
entries.reject_reason: This RDS for Oracle upgrade-setting change is outside the AI interests.

entries.original_title: What’s new on Prime Video in November 2026, including ‘The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power’ Season 3 and ‘Campus Drivers’
entries.subtitle: Prime Video brings The Greatest on November 4, The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 on November 11, and live sports.
entries.reject_reason: A Prime Video programming schedule does not match the AI research, product, or model interests.
